entry.name: EnchantedScimitarFlavor
entry.value: A blade bound to forbidden Warp power. Its runes quicken each strike and drive its keen edge through armour.

entry.name: FallenCombiFlamerFlavor
entry.value: A boltgun and flamer combined into a single weapon, adapted for a servant of Chaos.

entry.name: FallenHereticStakeFlavor
entry.value: A boltgun stake loaded with a blasphemous round that is inscribed to hunt champions.

entry.name: FallenPowerSwordFlavor
entry.value: A power sword reforged for a servant of Chaos. Its edge is the same, only the hand that holds it has changed.
